name: Inspect & Vacuum Bare Ceiling
intent: Walk the bare-drywall ceiling before primer goes on. Look for high mud spots, telegraphing seams, fastener pops. Vacuum loose dust and joint-compound debris. Slower than wall inspection because the painter is craning the neck and inspecting against gravity-fall lighting.
doctrine: Ceiling pre-prime inspection runs ~17% slower than wall inspection (1250 vs 1500 SF/hr at QT2/3) because of neck strain and the angle of incident light. Ceiling vacuum is also slower (700 vs 800 SF/hr) because the painter is working overhead with vacuum hose drag. Height modifier matters more here than on walls because ladder work compounds the overhead penalty.
